name: branchyard
description: Delegate work to child branches with Branchyard: spawn, watch, integrate and cancel children within your envelope.

interface.longDescription: Delegate parts of a coding task to child branches with Branchyard: spawn a child on its own git branch and harness, watch its status and cost, integrate its validated result, and cancel it. Requires an installed `by` CLI on a Branchyard branch (BRANCHYARD_BRANCH set).
defaultPrompt: Use Branchyard to delegate part of this task to a child branch.
